source_title: Projector-Resolved Seed Calculus V / Multiresolution Signal Calculus

notation_translation.new_atlas: H_ks(u)=sum_m h(Nm+k-s) u^m; u is one coarse causal delay

application: For finite taps and zero-extended causal sequences, each coefficient is a finite sum. The exact routing identities therefore apply formally to the illustrated growing sequences without an l^p norm assumption. Bounded l^p operator-norm statements are not invoked for Fibonacci.
separate_series_note: This source is Seed Calculus V, distinct from Special Functions V.
scope: Source extraction, index translation and the cited finite convolution identities; no global priority claim.
